actualRawTraceStorage: Retained privately under the fresh external diagnostic run directory, mode0600 inside mode0700 parents.
indicatorScanLimitation: Absence of common credential indicators is not proof of no secrets; actual trace excluded regardless.
publishedTraceDerivation: Only operation categories, numeric timing/geometry, counts and hashes. No raw trace log text, headers, params, response bodies, console messages or stack data.
actualResultReview: Original receipt stores route classes, timestamps, hash bindings, generated fixture IDs and setup/action status, not API bodies/headers. Browser collector retains no keys or values.
staticTraceScope: Minimal authored DOM only, known public fixture purposes, no account/auth/provider or APIs. All credential indicator scan counts zero.
